reason: When I need a fixture I need it in hand in a week or two, and 10 to 12 business days is basically three weeks. I've never heard of this store, so I'm not betting a deadline on it.
objection: 10 to 12 business days is a long wait for a light, and if it shows up late or wrong I've got a turnover and a guest check-in with an empty ceiling and no easy way out, since I'd pay return shipping on a bulky box.
would_change_my_mind: A firm delivery date I could count on in under a week or two, with a store I can trust to hit it, or a free-returns policy for a damaged or wrong item.
